profile.headline: Fullstack Software Developer
profile.summary:
Fullstack software developer with nearly 9 years of experience working with a variety of technologies.
 
Over my career, I have worked in all sorts of environments including start-ups, late-stage startups, to very large established companies. 

I have worked on back-end APIs, data-layers, and services/micro-services utilizing a variety of database systems, including MS SQL, POSTGres, and AWS DynamoDB.  

Additionally, I have worked on front-facing applications such as traditional Windows software and web applications, including server-side rendered Razor pages, React, and Angular applications. 
I also have experience with messaging systems such as SignalR and RabbitMQ, for cross platform interaction in a complex applications environment.  

Lastly, I am very used to Scrum and Agile methodology and adhere strongly to its principles, but am also flexible. I utilize JIRA extensively, along with Git, but also have experience with Bitbucket and TFS, as well.

As a worker, I consider myself a team player that can operate extremely well on their own or in collaboration with peers. I am accommodating of my team members and am always happy to offer help as well as take advice/criticism. Although I consider myself competent, I am humble and know my limits; I easily accept that I can be wrong or ignorant and am not afraid to reach out for answers.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full stack engineer supporting a distributed ecosystem of microservices and microsites.
Supported, built, and modernized legacy ASP.NET MVC webapp and .NET 8.0 backend and Extjs and Vuejs frontends with a custom component library built on Bootstrap.
Built and maintained .NET Core services (both Restful APIs and Lambdas) with data driven by SQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and AWS data stores like DynamoDB, DocumentDb, Athena, etc.
Managed message-driven architectures with RabbitMQ and observability via Datadog for production troubleshooting.
Drove CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins with source control across Bitbucket and Gitlab.
Leverage AI for assisted development and explored agentic patterns. 
Agile
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · Ext JS · ASP.NET MVC · Elasticsearch · SQL · C# · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · .NET Core · Gitlab

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Onboarded as a FTE, working on internal applications that support business-to-business deals. Day to day involves working in full stack, in a variety of client and server applications managed in TFS and Git.

Some of the technologies involved are React, Semantic UI, WinForms, .NET, and SQL Server.
In addition to the tech stack, worked as part of a small operational unit working in collaboration with many, which composed the Marketplace Division. As such, ramped up quick on workflow and business concepts, helped push for best practices, and maintained good communication between myself, my team, and other units.
positions.insights: Skills: Postman · C# · JavaScript · RabbitMQ · React.js · Microsoft SQL Server · ASP.NET MVC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contractual via Aquesst
Full Stack Development involving various internal services, a backend API service, and a front-end user interface.

Backend implemented as a distributed system of Lambda functions and CloudFront configurations that allowed access to an API service, which used .NET Core/C# and Entity Framework.
Includes RDS (MSSQL), Non-SQL data storage systems such as ElasticSearch and DynamoDB.
Also included configuration of IAM roles, Secrets Management, and Cognito Users, as well as maintaining Build Pipelines for deploying these services.

Frontend consisted of a internal and external, end-user endeavor.
Internal web services built on an Angular (8) Application, which integrated with Auth0 for authentication between clients and server.

End-user application can be seen at localnow.com and is built on top of a Next.js application (React).

Source Control based on Git.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · JavaScript · AngularJS · Elasticsearch · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Microsoft SQL Server · ASP.NET MVC

positions.title: Mid Developer
positions.description:
Full-stack software development ona  web service utilizing MVC5 under Agile/Scrum Methodology
Worked on back and and front end about 50-50.
Backend based on MSSQL/T-SQL and C#/.NET. Core interface between server and data utilized Entity Framework.
Frontend based on HTML5, Javascript, and CSS; 
Work on client involved libraries such as JQuery, AmplifyJS, FabricJS, Canvas, ...
Heavy use of Twitter Bootstrap and W2UI.
In addition to building out new features and web pages, also maintain and updated code to meet evolving coding standards (Transforming legacy Javascript code to utilize ES6)

Maintained legacy software, which was based on Microsoft Silverlight.

Our VCS was based on Bitbucket (Git).
Responsibilities also included installing and maintaining instances of JetBrains TeamCity and Octopus Deploy as part of our pipeline. 

Aided in the hiring process and mentored new hires
Interacted with customers to gauge feedback on product and to troubleshoot
defects
Interacted with integrating third-parties to understand requirements and to
implement features according to supplied external APIs and Systems.

• Development: Works with a team on an MVC5 application, which utilized Javascript, C#, HTML5, CSS, and T-SQL.

• Project: The project follows the Agile methodology with the development team being partitioned into Scrum teams.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Performed at the Georgia Renaissance Festival as a representative of Unit2 Fitness and the Atlanta Freifechters Historical European Martial Arts group. The event and presence was a collaboration between the Atlanta Freifechters and the Palmetto Knights.

Duties included demonstration of swordsmanship and historical techniques, administering and assisting in fencing lessons, and performing/sparring in front of an audience.

In addition to managing the KSU Fencing Club/HEMA/Historical Fencing, I was also in charge of compiling lessons, itineraries, and running classes as head instructor. 

Following my graduation, and hence, ineligibility to be club president, I still perform the duties of Historical Fencing Instructor as a volunteer.

projects.title: Hashibirokou
projects.description: A specialized solution that utilizes MVC5, Entity Framework, Twitter API, Google Cloud API, and Discord API, this project was an automated data mining platform that collected data from Twitter using dynamic queries, processed in certain ways using Google Cloud Services, and then sent to Discord.

projects.title: Orthodontic Practice Management Software
projects.description:
This is a full suite application, implemented in .NET, Javascript, and HTML5, using Microsoft T-SQL as the database framework.

This allows Orthodontic and Dental practices to access their offices' data via browser, from anywhere.
